title: Remove stale analyzer plugin
prompt:
In analysis_options.yaml, replace these exact lines:
    strict-raw-types: true
  plugins:
    - custom_lint
  errors:
with:
    strict-raw-types: true
  errors:
The project does not declare custom_lint or riverpod_lint as dependencies. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -F -U -q $'    strict-raw-types: true\n  errors:' analysis_options.yaml && dart analyze analysis_options.yaml
